notes.title: Quadrilateral Cowboy July 2025 update
notes.notes:
A couple fixes for Quadrilateral Cowboy:

Recording crash fix. There was a crash issue caused by the recorded events. Recorded events need to be initialized with default values, and this was sometimes not happening. This is now fixed.
Fixed startup issue with Mac build. The Mac build was not starting correctly due to a file being in the wrong folder. This is now fixed.

Thanks to Ethan Lee & Jesper Jensen for this update 🙏🙏🙏

notes.title: Update 009: The Video Update
notes.notes:
The game had some video issues... they're now fixed! Big huge thanks to Ethan Lee for making this update happen 🙏


Fixes
Fixed fullscreen issue. There was an issue where switching to fullscreen would result in the screen extending beyond the boundaries of the monitor. This is now fixed.

Fixed desktop resolution issue. There was an issue where changing the game resolution would affect the size/resolution of the operating system desktop. This is now fixed.

Windowed mode issue. There was an issue where switching to windowed mode would sometimes position the window beyond the boundaries of the monitor. The window position now defaults to the center of the screen.

Brightness issue. There was an issue where adjusting the video brightness option would affect the brightness of the operating system desktop. This is now fixed.

notes.title: Update 008: Mac/Linux 64-bit update
notes.notes:
The Mac & Linux builds of Quadrilateral Cowboy are now 64-bit! This update should alleviate technical issues some folks were having on these platforms.

To celebrate this update, we're discounting Quadrilateral Cowboy 50% for the next few days. Enjoy!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/240440/Quadrilateral_Cowboy

notes.title: Update 006: Mac/Linux Release
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25628237/df426d1f57265b1aefb45cf077587cb9f6eaa760.png
Quadrilateral Cowboy is now live on the Mac and Linux platforms. The Art Book is now also available on Mac and Linux.

Further additions:
Resolution list now auto-populates with supported resolutions.
Added automatic setting to aspect ratio selection.
Menu mouse sensitivity now scales to screen resolution.


If you have any feedback or notes, please post in the Quadrilateral Cowboy messageboard.

notes.title: Update 004: The Primordial Soup Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25628237/410b94c66f64d54e6e4dd3e3fa2762dca89571ac.png

The Primordial Soup Update
Three maps have been added to Quadrilateral Cowboy.
The maps are early iterations and prototypes made during the middle of development.
Download the maps via the Steam Workshop.
Once downloaded, activate the mod via the main menu MODS menu, and then start a new campaign.

Changes

Main menu: fixed some issues with overlapping windows.
Main menu: starting a new game now chooses the first map in maplist.txt

notes.title: Update 001: The Citrus Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25628237/c87eab829e698b162630dc2a34f355f4bdd73a10.png

The Citrus Update
Oranges have been added to Quadrilateral Cowboy.

The oranges have been distributed across the maps.
They can be held in your hands.
Try to find them all.


Changes

Deck: now displays correctly after save/load.
Deck: fixed some stability issues.
Recipe: added a chile recipe.
Vinylman: music now stops when exiting or resetting simulator.
Stock Exchange: turned off some monitors that were accidentally left on.
Finale: fixed a photo that was not rotating.
Leaderboards: fixed a few maps that weren't tracking global average times.
Leaderboards: now only submits time when in standard gamemode.
Music: fixed incorrect music cues in a few workshop areas.
Holiday decorations: removed some stray holiday decorations.
Funicular: vault doors no longer levitate into outer space.

notes.title: One week until release of Quadrilateral Cowboy
notes.notes:
I'm very excited to announce Quadrilateral Cowboy will be released on July 25, 2016 at 10AM PST.

The initial launch will be for Windows, with the Mac and Linux builds coming in September 2016. Read more info at: http://blendogames.com/qc

See you in a week!
